title: Goldreich–Levin Coefficient Program
statement: Given a deterministic Goldreich–Levin input and a finite family of frequency sets in its dimension, define a deterministic query program that first charges the small-bias construction work for the coefficient-estimation generator. It then queries the sign cube at every sample generated by that input, charges local work equal to the family size times the coefficient-estimation local-work bound, and returns the sparse Fourier hypothesis formed from the answers.
hypotheses_covered: The input's small-bias parameters have positive dimension and numerator, with twice the numerator at most the denominator.
The Fourier bound is a natural number at least one.
The family is a finite set of frequency sets in the input dimension.
caveat: The supplied statement omits definitions of the coefficient input, sample set, work bounds, and answer-to-hypothesis construction, preventing a fully self-contained account of those quantities.
